invariants.rationale: The method always constructs a new HoodieWriteMetadata object to return, so 'result' should never be null.
'table' is accessed unconditionally, so it must not be null at method exit.
'executor' is cast to BaseJavaCommitActionExecutor and used, so it must not be null.
'inputRecords' is passed to other methods and used to perform the bulk insert, so it must not be null.
'result' is constructed as a new HoodieWriteMetadata and is returned explicitly.
